name: sprite-motion-kit
description: AI-authored custom game actions and body rigs, local 3D mannequin references, sprite export and visual review.

interface.shortDescription: Design custom 3D poses and generate matching sprite actions.
interface.longDescription: The host AI designs character-specific joint trees, attacks, locomotion and falls; local tools render 3D mannequin references, export transparent character frames and synchronize visual review. No model access or credits bundled.
defaultPrompt: Design two different attacks for this character using custom 3D mannequin references, then generate and review the sprites.
Create a body-appropriate monster collapse with its own rig and key poses.
Author a custom motion plan for this character and show the 3D reference before generating its animation.
